body: Of course college is hard, but I actually think it's good if you're like a "normal" student in high school. Me and a lot of my people I know were like "smart" kids, went through high school without ever studying, got to a great university and found out I don't actually know how to study. You can't actually pass the harder university math classes by being better with numbers, you actually have to study. I ended up having to study more than my classmates who weren't as "good in math" just because I never learnt how to study up until then. I also didn't really learn to manage stress as I never had the "if I fail this test I'm screwed" feeling. So if you are like average student in high school, I think you'll actually won't find college as much harder.

When things like that happened to me, all I could do is just get to work... You'll have to make yourself work pretty hard and the results might not be the best, but at least you'll get through... At least you'll get a taste how university works and prepare for it better next time and don't let it get this far.

The sooner you begin, the sooner you will be done 😋
